status.now: Contract software engineer at PowerChat, building its developer platform and payments program.
status.also: Founder and sole engineer of OpenVibe: seven services, 20+ domains, one operator.

pitch: Full-stack engineer with 10+ years shipping production systems and a habit of owning them end to end. I designed and run OpenVibe, an open live-streaming and tools network of seven Node services behind one identity provider. At PowerChat I turned the product into an OAuth2 platform and rebuilt its payments across five processors. Before that I ran SOX-compliance analytics at Amazon, shipped autonomous research agents analysts used daily, and spent three years in sales at Verizon Wireless — district top performer, promoted to Assistant Manager, coaching 4-8 reps. I've also run my own company, GameServerStats, for 10+ years. I'm genuinely open to where that combination fits: engineering, platform, analytics, ops or something in between.
